Employee.title: Employee
Employee.description: Information about a business employee and their base salary

MonthlyRecord.title: Monthly Record
MonthlyRecord.description: Aggregated monthly salary, duty days, overtime, withdrawals, and carry forwards

dutyDays.description: Number of active working days in the month

carryForwardIn.description: Negative balance carried forward from previous month

totalEarned.description: Total earned salary based on dutyDays

totalWithdrawals.description: Sum of all withdrawals for this month

finalSalary.description: Calculated net salary: earned + overtime - withdrawals - carry_forward_in

carryForwardOut.description: Negative final balance to carry forward to the next month

Withdrawal.title: Withdrawal
Withdrawal.description: An advance payment (upad) taken by the employee

note.description: Reason or remark for the advance

createdBy.description: UID of the admin who added this entry

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Instant alert notification record for employee push and dashboard updates

employeeId.description: Ref to the target employee login ID

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.description: System role mapping associated with an authenticated Auth UID

employeeId.description: Associated employee login ID, if applicable

/employees/{employeeId}.description: Master list of all employees in the system

/employees/{employeeId}/monthlyRecords/{.description: Monthly aggregates of working days, salary details, and carry forwards

/employees/{employeeId}/withdrawals/{wit.description: Transactions of advances (upad) taken by this employee

/notifications/{notificationId}.description: Push and in-app system notifications for employees

/profiles/{uid}.description: Metadata routing profile linked directly to authenticated users
